evals.prompt: Generate a PBS header for 2 chunks, 4 MPI ranks per chunk and 8 threads per rank, with 32 GB per chunk and 30 minutes in the compute queue.
evals.expected_output: The header separates the per-chunk CPU and memory resources from the job-wide walltime.
assertions: Each chunk requests 32 CPUs for four MPI ranks and eight threads per rank.
Walltime and queue are separate PBS directives.

script_checks.description: Uniform PBS MPI and OpenMP resource request

evals.prompt: Generate a PBS header with one default CPU chunk, no queue override, and a one-hour time limit.
evals.expected_output: One CPU, one rank and one thread are requested in a single chunk.
assertions: The scheduler defaults supply the memory and queue.

evals.prompt: Generate a PBS header with a walltime of 01:72:00.
evals.expected_output: The malformed walltime is rejected as invalid.
assertions: The script exits with code 2 for invalid input.

script_checks.description: Reject walltime with a minute component above 59
